caption:
Social Security checks are getting a 3.6% raise in 2027. 📬

The Social Security Administration announced the cost-of-living adjustment in October, and notices go out in December.

A raise is nice. But it only helps if it outruns your bills.

Does 3.6% feel like enough where you live?
